goal: Attempt-budget keys declared in flywheel.toml -- the top-level [deadlines] per-class wall-clock table and [sandbox.limits] rubric_judge_max_turns -- take effect on the worker run path's HarnessConfig instead of the code defaults.

graders.name: policy-parse-oracle
graders.run:
uv run python -c '
import tempfile, pathlib
from flywheel_orchestrator._policy import load_policy
from flywheel_core.deadline_config import DeadlineConfig
body = """[source]
kind = "directory"

[deadlines]
agent_iteration_seconds = 5400
rubric_judge_seconds = 0

[sandbox.limits]
rubric_judge_max_turns = 48
"""
bare_body = """[source]
kind = "directory"
"""
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p = pathlib.Path(d) / "flywheel.toml"
    p.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
    pol = load_policy(p)
    p.write_text(bare_body, encoding="utf-8")
    bare = load_policy(p)
assert pol.deadlines.agent_iteration_seconds == 5400.0, pol.deadlines
assert pol.deadlines.rubric_judge_seconds is None, pol.deadlines
assert pol.deadlines.command_grader_seconds == 900.0, pol.deadlines
assert pol.sandbox.limits.rubric_judge_max_turns == 48, pol.sandbox.limits
assert bare.deadlines == DeadlineConfig(), bare.deadlines
assert bare.sandbox.limits.rubric_judge_max_turns is None, bare.sandbox.limits
print("policy-parse-oracle ok")
'
